name: flow_hub_causeway_backdrop
description: Behind the hub stands the Causeway at low water (design 5.1, 5.2; world.md), built from its own props, not drawn: the road (models/causeway/road.glb) chained along +Z out to the haze, tide poles along it, waymark cairns and wrack on the flats, in a 3D world of its own under a low sun; the camera drifts slowly along the road and comes round again after one tile of props, so the drift never ends. The loading screen stands on the same Causeway.

steps.msg: the road, chained 2 units at a time out to the haze
tide poles along it, cairns and wrack on the flats
a 3D world of its own, seen through its own camera
the camera drifts along the road
and comes round after one tile (24 units), where the road and its props repeat
